eventDetail.scope: ICMOCE 2027 will provide an international forum for the exchange of ideas on state-of-the-art research in microwave, optical and communication engineering, as well as other allied areas. The fields of interest are as follows; Antennas and Antenna Arrays; Conformal Antennas; Microwave Circuits; MMIC; THz Systems; Quantum Antennas; Optical Fiber Technology; Optical Devices and Sensors; Optical Signal Processing; Optical Wireless Techniques; Photonic Applications; PhIC; Quantum Photonics; Communication Networks; Next-Generation Communication; Modulation and Coding Theory; Signal Processing for Communication; Augmented and Virtual Reality in Communication; AI for Biosensing; Bio-Photonics; Bio-Radar; Microwave Imaging; Microwave Sensors for Healthcare; AI Assisted Transportation, Agriculture & Healthcare; AI Applications in Communication & Radar
